tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kyai rdor sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañju badz+ra ya/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang/ /kyai rdo rje la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs yan lag drug /ngag 'don kha skong cung zad brjod| | 'di la thun gyi dngos gzhi'i dang*/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'o/ / dang po la ring ba'i dang nye ba'i sngon 'gro'o/ / dang po ni/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /zhes sogs mdo sngags kyi lam phal cher sngon du song bas 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pas spyi dgos kyi mtshan nyid tshang ba'i gnas su nyer mkho gang 'dzoms tshogs par bya la/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sgrub grogs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis kyai'i rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu'am rtsa phyag gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la yum rdo rje bdag med ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par 'gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sā bhā wa shung+nghaḥsarba dharmāḥsā bhā washung+nghau3 haṃ/ nang mchod stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ āḥlas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/ āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor| de'i steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bruṃ las dri chen/ lhor aṃ las rak+ta/ nub du dz+rīṃ las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du khaṃ las klad pa/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bruṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ mnyam pa nyid ky-i ye shes/ nub du dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/

byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ de'i mthar g.yon bskor du/ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ ai ai o au aṃ aḥ g.yas bskor du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha| de'i steng du oṃdakar po mgo thur du blta ba'i steng du/ raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i sa bon hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung g.yos me spar bas/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge lnga dang bcas pa zhu rlangs pa oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa thod par lhung pa'i rlangs pa dang*/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas bkug rdo rje la thim pas/ rdo rje nyi ma dang oṃ dang hūṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung nas rdzas thams cad zhu ste kha dog dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa dang ha ho hri/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma'i mchod gtor yang mchod pa byin brlab 'og nas 'byung pa bzhin dang*/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ 'og g-i mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dbul| bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa byin brlabs ni/ mdun du bshams pa'i mchod rdzas rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pas nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pas/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs/

sgrib pa sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su 'chi'o/ /sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la'o= 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o/ /rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse mo lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs| tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de 'od du zhu yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dṛl bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ skyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/

lus thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'i rnam pas rkang pa'i mtheb bong nas 'dzags par 'gyur/ ngag tu/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bhā wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sing+nghi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+tāṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas nas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa/ sgrib pa/ nyes pa/ ltung ba/ dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab bo/ / gnyis pa rgyud snod rung du byed pa'i tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭāṃ ga yod pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po can du gyur/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs shing 'od zer phyir 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu brgyan pa spyan drangs/ phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slon dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phogs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/

/ces brjod/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ/ ni wī ti hūm̐ khaṃ/ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃbadz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃbadz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi t+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ gis dbul/ rang gi yid kyis sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis/ bdud rtsi lnga grub pa'i dngul chu/ cang te'u'i sgra/ 'khyud pa'i bde bas mchod par mos la/ nam mkhar rje btsun ltas nas ni/ /rdo rje skye ba snying rje che/ /rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi / / lha mo brgyad po rnams kyis mchod/ /dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma ri ni sman 'dzin cing*/ /puk+kasi ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pa/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid| |ces brjod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog bsnyes pa/ khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ / snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can bsad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pas rdo rje sgrub pa yis/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /zhes pas bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa tham cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rang bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bar bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/

/sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer| |byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ / dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon chog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*| |yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi| |rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung pa'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa tham cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /zhes pa lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig

duḥkha dang duḥkha'i rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cigachags sdang nye ring gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces pas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom dngos gzhi la bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi dang po la gsum las 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ gis chos thams cad rnam thar sgo bzhi'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ bar do longs sku'i rnal 'byor ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bo oṃ āḥ hūm̐ rnams ho dmar po gnyis kyi bar du chud pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de la bar chad bsrung ba'i don du bsrung 'khor bsgoms pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba 'thing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng du bhuṃ ser po zhu ba las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i khog pa stong pa rtsibs bcu dang ldan pa go skabs med pa kha dog ser po/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+ruṃ hūm̐ gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du bruṃ ser po/ phyogs bcu'i steng du hūm̐ re re/ de'ang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de thams cad so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug gtor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/

shar du gshen rje gshed tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du stobs po che rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar snol nas 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes gtun shing 'dzin pa'o/ /hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad/ g.yas pa phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa/ shes rab mthar byed dang*/ pad ma mthar byed ma gtogs pa gzhan thams cad sngon po/ phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og gi khro bo rnams rab tu khros pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzais pa sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ mtshams kyi khro bo rnams cung zad zhi ba/ skra nag po can/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ badz+ra kro dha rā dzā sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs se gol gdab/ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ gis shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas rigs lnga spyan drangs/ snga ma ltar mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñcha tu maṃ gis gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas gshen rje gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/

gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ yang rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ lus thams cad la khyab pa'i rdo rje gtams pa'i gos gyon/ yang rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhu ba las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba'i nang tu/ rang gi shes pa hūm̐ sngon por gyur pa'i steng du bla ma/ g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du spun zla/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yog 'og tu nor rdzas la sogs pa'i bsrung bya rnams dmigs te/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros khro bo la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ bdag bsrung ba'i don du sngags 'don/ 'khor lo la phog pas 'khor lo g.yas bskor du myur du 'khor bas dgra bgegs phye mar byas par bsgoms zhing/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta dharmā nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ sit+ta ta pa tri/ oṃ bi ma la| oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ oṃ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti/ sarba yan+t+ra man+t+ra/ mū la karma/ ban+dha nāṃ| ta ḍā nā/ kī lā naṃ/ wa ma ma kṛ te ye na ke na tsi ta/ kṛ tan+ta ta/ sarban+tu/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ma ra ma ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes dang/ oṃ bha ya nā sa ni/ trā sa ni/ sarba mā pra t+yaṃ gā+-i ra/ bi nā sa ni/ ye ke tsita/ duṣ+ta na sa twa/ ma ma bi ru pa kaṃ kurban+ti tā ni/ sarba ma ra ni pra t+yanagī ra ni pa ta tu hūm̐ṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas te/ gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ sems can thams cad la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sbyor ba phyin ci log byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na/ de'i tshe de thams cad kyi lus bcing par gyi'o/

/ngag bcing par bgyi'o| |yid bcing par bgyi'o/ mthu brlag par gyur cig stobs rlags par 'gyur cig de la 'go ba'i lhas de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa'i 'bras bu de nyid la 'byung bar gyur cig khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlogs| rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /zhes brjod pas/ dgra bgegs bsgral nas/ rnam shes mi skyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i phyir yan lag drug las/

gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ni/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ gzhi'i yan lag e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du rgyu'i yan lag yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu gdungs pa lta bu/ chang zungs dang mchog ma la yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pa as mtshan pas brgyan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa dang lte ba la laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bruṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu drug pa bruṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de lnga dang rkyen gyi yan lag bar snang gi yi ge las babs pa'i rang gi sems oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho dmar po gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i bar do'i rnam shes dang chag gcig du 'dres pa las/ chos 'byung gi nang du sna tshogs pad ma dang rdo rje la gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du nag po ljang khu dmar po ser po dkar po'i rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la/ dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shu yod pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi rtsa ba'i steng du 'dod yon gyi snam bu la lha mo bcu drug mchod rdzas du ma thogs pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus byur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo'i thad so bzhir ka ba bzhis btegs pa'i rta bab bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/

chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gos dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang par gyur/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba| byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag tu rgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa mi bzad pa/ nub byang du kī li kī li'i sgra sgrogs pa'i dur khrod do/ /de'i nang na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong pa brgyad ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor gshen rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa/ dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po khyu mchog la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ phyag bzhi g.yas pa gnyis kyis mchod sbyin dang dbyug gu gsum pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang*/ ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa| nub byang du rlung lha ljang sngon shwa ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ thams cad rgyan gyis brgyan zhing rang 'dra'i rig mas g.yon nas brten pa la lag pa g.yon pas 'khyud cing*/ spyi bos bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa/ shing chen po brgyad ni/ shi ri sha tsu ta/ kaṃ ka la/ a shwad tha/ shing chen po/ ka ran dza/ 'khril shing can/ arju na rnams so/ /de rnams na gnas pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad ni| shar du lha'i dge 'dun dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he'i gdong pa can/ nub tu sprin gyi rgyal po dmar po chu srin gyi gdong pa can/

byang du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ser po rta'i gdong pa can/ byang shar du yi dwags 'dus pa dud kha glang gi gdong pa can/ shar lhor drang srong 'dus pa dmar po ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ lho nub tu srin po'i tshogs can nag po ro langs kyi gdong pa can/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang sngon shwa ba'i gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang shing lo'i gseb na gnas pa'i lus phyed 'thon pa/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /klu chen po brgyad ni/ shar na nor rgyas ser po/ lhor pad+ma dkar po/ nub tu kar ko ṭa nag po/ byang du 'jog po dmar po/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po dkar po/ shar lhor hu lun ta sngon po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan ljang khu| nub byang du dung skyong ser po rnams sbrul mgo'i mdengs ka dang ldan zhing sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /sprin chen po brgyad ni/ shar du sgrogs byed ser po/ lhor ldog byed sngon po/ nub tu 'jigs byed dkar po/ byang du 'khor byed ser po/ byang shar du 'thug po dkar po/ shar lhor 'gengs byed dmar po/ lho nub tu char 'bebs nag po/ nub byang du gtum po ljang khu rnams so/ gzhan yang mchod rten brgyad/ chu bo brgyad/ me brgyad| grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ dpa' bo dang/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gang ba/ ro dang*/ ro langs dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ sha za'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar| byang ljang dbus sngo ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po| 'dab ma brgyad la shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/

shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thag bzang ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan du 'gyur/ de nas gzhal yas khang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rten rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur| oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ni la yā badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod de nga rgyal bzung ngo/ / gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan so gnyis kyi bdag nyid shail gyi phreng ba lta bu'i/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa/ ā lis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa/ kā lis mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od dang bcas pa so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ kyai'i rdo rje'i go 'phangs la bkod/ tshur 'dus zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de yongs su gyur pa las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas zhal sngo/ g.yon zhal dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ rgyab zhal nag po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug 'dzin pa'i/ g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/

de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang khu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la yang mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan zhing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs bas kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yum gyi mkha' ā las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ze 'bru la ās mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ dga' ba bzhi'i 'byung gnas su gyur| oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra ma hā rā ga su khaṃ/ da da/ tsa tur ā nan+da bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ka t+ya ku ru ṣ+wa me/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwe ṣa tsa tur ā nan+da da ya ka kha ka mu kha e ka rā so nā tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kad+ya ku ru ṣ+wa me/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ yab yum gnyis ka snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha si si kun dhu ru badz+ra dhṛka ces pa'i sgras/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi khar babs/ thig le brgyad du gyur| de rnams gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ/ sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu lha mo brgyad du gyur nas/ yum gyi kha nas phyir 'thon te/ gdan so so'i steng du rim pa bzhin 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau ri nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau ri dmar mo g.yas ḍa ma ru/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu bet+ta li ser mo g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma ri ljang khu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du pūk+ka si sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong/ g.yon mkhar sil 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong bshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gar thabs kyi ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / gsum pa skye ba sprul sku'i lam 'khyer ni/ yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pa mthong ba'i rkyen gyis nam mkha'i bar do yab kyi zhal nas zhugs pa/ yab yum dang lhan cig rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu nas/ bdud bzhi'i steng du bde pa chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin thig ler gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal bzung/ de nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i don du/

pūk+ka si la sogs pa lha mo bzhis/ tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bo'am sgo nas rim pa bzhin glus bskul bar gyur/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig/pu k+ka si ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ khyod med na ni bdag gum pas| |kyai yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ / ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer bas/ / stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyi/ /bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyed bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /cais brjod pas thig le de hūm̐ aṃ sngon po 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de zhu ba las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ rgyab zhal bzhi nag pa/ gzhan me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sngar bzhin no/ /lha bcu'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa la gnas pa'i sa bon/ huṃ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ rnams las 'od 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can la phog lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar ḍaṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar saṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying mkhar naṃ las bdag med ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs khar hūṃ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/

thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang*/ mgo bo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la skyil dkrungs phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa mā dzaḥse gol gdab| |sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ rang gi snying kha nas gau ri lcags kyu thogs pa spros/ lcags kyu ye shes pa rnams kyi thugs kar reg pas/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du byon/ tsau ri zhags pa thogs pa spros/ mgrin par zhags pas reg pas bdag la thim/ bet+tu li lcags sgrog thogs pa spros/ zhabs la lcags sgrog gis reg pas bdag la mnyes bzhin du mi 'bral bar byas par gyur/ ghasma ri dril bu thogs pa spros/ dril bu'i sgras bkug ste/ bdag gi dbang du gyur/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la g.yas pa'i mdzub mos mdud pa lcags kyu dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi rgyab kyi rtse sprad de/ mig dang ldan par byas par zhags pa dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung gnyis dang mdzub mo gnyis lug gu brgyud du sbrel ba lcags sgrog gi dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur rgyab sprad nas mnyam te mnan pa dril bu'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā rā gau ri ār+ṣa ya dzaḥ tsau ri pra be sha ya hūm̐/ bait+ta li ban+dha baṃ/ ghasma ri wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes brjod do/ /

gsum pa dbang skur ba mi skyod pa'i yan lag ni/ de nas rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rigs lnga/ yum bzhi| byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu spyan drangs/ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥse gol gdab| sngar bzhin mchod pa'i rjes su/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po kun/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mgon| |las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod| |bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ zhes brjod pas rigs lngas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa'i/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu blangs/ byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mo drug gis mchod nas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi skyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag rnams la rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhes brjod cing don dran par bya/ dbang gi chu rgyun des mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dgagasang ba'i dbang thob/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo las kyi phyag rgya/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi phyag rgya/

mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo phyag rgya chen po/ zhes brjod cing don dran par bya'o/ /chu rgyun des snying kha yan chad gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes brjod cing don dran par bya/ chu rgyun des rkang 'thil yan chad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dgadabang bzhi pa thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ gau ri dang*/ puk+ka si la mi skyod pas dbu brgyan/ tsau ri dang*/ sha wa ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ bet+ta li dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍa li la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma ri dang ḍoṃbhi ni la 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid du mos te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ / bzhi pa bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i yan lag ni/ nang mchod sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis lan gsum dkrugs te dbus nas blangs nas gtor zhing mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du yum dang*/ lha mo rnams kyi snying po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ btags la phul bas/ lha thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mnyes par mos la/ oṃ sa rba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyas bzung ngo/ / lnga pa mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag ni/ lha mo brgyad kyis rang nyid la sngar bzhin mchod par mos la/

dkar mo ri dwags kyi rjes su bdag nyid la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin don grub kyi ngo bo mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod par mos te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ drug pa bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ni / lha mo de rnams kyis bdag la mgrin gcig tu bstod par mos te/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis rjes su/ bdag nyid la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor bstod pa sna tshogs pas bstod par mos te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu sti badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3 haṃ/ lha dang gzhal yas khang snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon dang 'dra ba la dmigs pa gtad la yid mnyam par bzhag go / gnyis pa brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas te/ rlung ro gsal la/ lus kyi dbus kyi spy-i gtsug nas lte ba'i bar la/ rtsa dbu ma phra zhing gsal ba thig le'i dwangs mas gang ba/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo rak+tas gang ba/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo khu bas gang ba/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su aḥ nang bskor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ a ka tsa ṭa pa ya sha phyi'i 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la g.yon bskor du ā li phrag gnyis/ g.yas skor du ha dang k+ṣaḥspangs pa'i kā li so gnyis/ thams cad kyang mdog dmar po/ mgo gyen la lta ba/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo lte bar hūm̐/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar nas brtsams pa'i phyogs bzhir bruṃ aṃ dzṛṃ khaṃ/ me nas brtsams ste mtshams bzhir/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ rnaṃs mdog sngon po/ mgo bo mthur du blta ba/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ/ 'dab ma bcu drug la g.yon bskor du/ ā li bcu drug mgo gyen du blta ba/ mdog dmar po/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i lte ba la haṃ/ 'dab ma so gnyis la g.yon bskor du ā li phrag gnyis thams cad mdog dkar po/

mgo bo thur du blta ba la dmigs nas 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum kyi sbyor bas 'og gi rlung g.yos| lte ba'i a las me byung bas g.yas ro ma'i me dang 'grogs te gyen du 'bar bas/ snying mgrin gyi 'khor lo bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas/ haṃ las byang sems kyi rgyun g.yon rkyang ma'i thig le dang sdongs nas babs pas/ mgrin snying gi 'khor lo gsos gtab/ thigs pa gcig lte ba'i a la phog pas/ a las me shin tu phra ba dbu ma nas yar song bas| snying kha'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ bcom/ spyi bo'i haṃ la bsnun pas haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dbu ma nas babs/ oṃ dang hūm̐ gsal btab nas/ lte snying gi dbus su me dang thig le ro gcig tu 'dres pas dkar dmar gyi rnam par gnas pa la yid kyis rtse gcig tu gtad la/ rlung kha sbyar nas gsal stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go / gnyis pa thun mtshams gy-i spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la brgyad las/ dag pa dran pa ni/ rdzogs rim las langs nas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor wal dran par byas la/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la// byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed kyi ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum mo/ /sha ni pu k+ka si ru brjod/ /de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma/ /gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod/ /g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu nyid/ /lpags pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ /rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid| |ces brjod cing don dran par bya'o/ / gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs khar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ rnams la dmigs te/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags bzlas pa'i tshe rang gi thugs kha'i huṃ las sngags phreng dmar po lcags sgrog sbrel ba lta bu 'phros/

rang gi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du bzhugs/ thugs kha'i aṃ la thim/ mkha' nas 'thon| yab kyi gsang gnas nas zhugs/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ de ltar 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bskul/ bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsam/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags bzlas pa'i tshe/ rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon la 'khor bar bsam zhing/ zlo ba'i tshe/ rang gi zhal brgyad dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu brjod par bsam zhing bzlas so// sngags ni/ oṃ aṣ+tā na nā ya/ piṅga lor+dha ke sha wat+ma ne/ tsa turbang+shi ti nai trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhū dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzā+-i mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la ne kā dhā ri ṇe/ adh+mā tā krū ra tsit+ta ya/ ar+dhen+du dam̐ ṣ+tī ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya| gar+dz+dzaya gar+dz+dza ya/ tar+dz+dza ya tar+dz+dza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rān/ ban+dha ban+dha/ nā gā.aṣ+ta kān/ gṛh+na gṛh+na/ sha trūn ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥphaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ni rtsa sngags sa ོ | oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ snying po'o/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri he badz+ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ āḥ.a ā/ i ī / u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi phreng sngags so / oṃ āḥnaṃ badz+ra nai rāt+mā hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi mtshan sngags so/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi nye snying ngo/ oṃ āḥgha badz+ra gau ri hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥgaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ badz+ra tsau ri hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ badz+ra be tā lī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ badz+ra ghasma ri hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥpaṃ badz+ra puk+ka sī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥpaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/

oṃ āḥshaṃ badz+ra sha wa rī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ shaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ badz+ra tsan+ṭa li hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥḍaṃ badz+ra ḍoṃ bhi ni hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ ḍaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ de rnams ni lha mo brgyad kyi mtshan sngags dang sa bon no/ /gsum pa mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par byed de/ 'og gi bya ba rnams byed par bsams la/ mdun du bshams pa'i mchod rdzas rnams byin rlabs sngar ltar byas te/ de nas mdun gyi ras bris sam/ me tog tshom bu la sogs pa sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba| gur/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i dbus su/ 'byung bzhi dang*/ 'khor lo dang rang gi sems gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi pa nas rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi bar sngar bzhin bskyed la/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad/ phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad nas/ nub byang du thag zangs ris dud kha rnams dgyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i bar sngar bzhin gsal gdab/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du*/ hūm̐ shrī he badz+ra ya na maḥ kyai rdo rje dang*/ nam badz+ra nai rād+ma yā na maḥ bdag med ma/ gaṃ badz+ra gau ri na maḥ gau ri/ tsaṃ badz+ra tsau ri na maḥ tsau ri/ baṃ badz+ra bait+ta li na maḥ bait+ta lī/ ghaṃ badz+ra ghasma ri na maḥ ghasma rī/ paṃ badz+ra pūk+ka si na maḥ puk+ka sī/ shaṃ badz+ra sha wa ri na maḥ sha ba rī/ laṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li na maḥ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ ḍaṃ badz+ra ḍoṃ bhi ni na maḥ

ḍom bhi ni rnams skad cig gis bskyed la/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams gong ltar gsal gdab/ de rnams kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ dpral bar sku rdo rje/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje/ sku mdog yid kyis gsal 'dab/ oṃ e h+ya hi la sogs pas ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ gau ri ā kār+ṣa ya dzaḥ sogs pas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ rigs lnga spyan drangs par mos la/ ni ri ti la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni nas/ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ gis dbang bskur/ sku thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dgadabang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ dbu rgyan sngar bzhin pa la gsal gdab/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ se gol gdab cing rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar zhing*/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rjas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /zhes dang*/ pad bskor byas la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis rtse sprad de phyag rgya byas la| badz+ra ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ dang*/ lag pa bsnol te se gol gdab cing swāhā zhes brjod pas zhabs bsil dang*/ de bzhin du sa pa ri wā ri'i rjes su/ badz+ra nai wī te hūm̐ khaṃ gis zhal bsil/ sarba saṃ sho dha nis 'thor 'thung/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥm hā ar+ghaṃ pra tā+-i ts+tshas mchod yon/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skyes gnas la dbang ba/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/

/bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /thal mo gnyis kha thur du bstan nas 'og nas drangs te/ steng du rdo rje khu tshur byas la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ me tog de bzhin du/ tshal bdag ro ni phan pa dang*/ /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /thal mo steng nas 'og tu bskor te khu tshur bcings la badz+ra dhū paṃ āḥhūm̐/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed pa/ /dge zhing mun pa rnams sel ba/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /thal mo 'og nas steng du bskor te/ mthe bong gnyis gshibs nas brkyang ba bskor ba'i tshul dang*| badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me dang*/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /thal mo steng nas 'og tu skor te/ snying khar khu tshur rgyab bstan pa bcas nas/ gyen du brkyang ste slar khu tshur bcings te spyi bor bzung la/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong*/ /sngags gyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod| |g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo gyen du bstan nas bzhag pa zhal zas 'bul ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ badz+ra nai wi t+ye āḥhūm̐ gi zhal zas| dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rjas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /badz+ra shap+da āḥhūm̐ dang hūm̐ dang āḥlas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa hūm̐ dang āḥs mtshan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lag pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes brjod cing lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje blangs te/ smin mtshams kyi thad kar lan gsum gsor/ hūm̐ zhes brjod snying khar bzung nas/

thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bor mos/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe a zhes brjod cing lag pa g.yon pas dril bu blangs te dkur bzung la/ a zhes brjod/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i stong nyid ston pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i ngo bor mos la| rang he ru kar dmigs la sku phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig dran par byas la/ dril bu gnas brgyad du dkrol zhing oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha we badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshe rang gi snying kha nas sprul pa'i lha mo mchod rjas de dang de thogs pa dpag tu med pa byung nas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par bsams te/ phyi'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas nang bdud rtsi myang pa'i skabs ltar mtheb srin gyis smin mtshams kyi thad kar phul te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhu tī pa/ gha ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che/ rdo rje 'chang/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dza lan dha ra pa| nag po brtul zhugs spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs can/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ glog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo blo gros grags/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po sogs/ rdo rje 'chang*/

bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad dha ka ra war ma/ jo bo rin chenabazang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal gyau blo gros grags/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po sogs/ rdo rje 'chang*| slob dpon klu sgrub/ bā li ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rat+na kīrti/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ gnang kha'u pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ bla ma brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ lo chen skyabs mchog mtshan can| byang sems nam mkha' 'od zer/ bcom ldan grags pa 'phel/ sde snod gsum| rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang rgyud man ngag gzhung 'grel thob pa'i dus gsum bla ma dam pa rnams kyi/ dkon mchog gsum mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu khyad par can rnams kyi/ dgyes rdor bde mchog la sogs pa'i yi dam gyi snying po'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/ de nas lus kyi lha mchod pa'i phyir/ lce rtse smin mtshams spyi bor gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ de nas chos skyong che chung gnyis dang*/ dgos kyi chos skyong gang byed kyi sngags gi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing skyong ba'i bka' sdod bsrung ma rnams kyi zhal du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro| gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'gro ba'i don la bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan/

bya rgod phung po'i ri/ dpal ldan 'bras phung gi mchod rten/ go ma la sa la'i mchod rten/ gnas brgyad gi mchod rten/ rgya'i ri bo rtse lnga/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri/ nub phyogs u rgyan/ byang shaṃ bha la/ 'phags pa shin kun la sogs pa/ rgya gar/ rgya nag/ li yul/ bal po la sogs pa gnas khyad par can gyi rten/ gtsug lag khang gi bsrung ma rnams kyi/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa/ lha sa/ yer pa/ dkar chung/ mtha' 'dul/ yang 'dul la sogs pa'i bod kyi gtsug lag khang gi bsrung ma rnams kyi/ mu gu lung*/ dge chu/ mkhar chung*/ sag thang sdings/ gnas gsar/ skya bo kha gdangs/ kha'u skyed las/ g.yung mkhar mo/ dpal ldan sa skya la sogs pa bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa khyad par can na gnas pa'i chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi/ phyogs skyong bcu/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ gnod sbyin| srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za*/ smyo byed/ rjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong| pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa'i/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cigathams cad kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la 'bul te/ nang gi mchod pa'o/ /de nas dkar mo ri dwags la sogs pa brjod de/ yid las byung pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs la sogs pa'i rjes su/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog |gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kyai yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud| |dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa/

/mgon po de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo rang steng nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag pa'i zhal rnams ni/ /gnag pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /skyes pa khyi dang ma he can/ /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /zhes par bsgyur na rgyud dang mthun la 'gyur yang legs/ g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung/ /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba bo/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhabs bzhi pos ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par gnan cing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang sngo/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi'i bdag nyid 'jigs/ /'dzags pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lnga yis yang dag brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bo mdzes// dpral ba rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa dga' bas yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gaṃ las skyes pa'i gau ri shar/ /yan lag gnag cing g.yon na nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /tsaṃ las skyes pa'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha mdog lho phyogs su//phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ /dbang po mnan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs mas ni nye dbang mnan/ /g.yon na lhung bzed g.yas pa na/ /rus sbal bsnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma ri ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang khu ghaṃ las byung ba yi/ /phyag gnyis sbrul dang thod pa sbrel/ /drag po mnan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje mnan cing paṃ las byung/ /g.yon na dgra rta seng ge g.yas/ /dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal pu ka si sngon la'o/ /ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung/ /me ru nor sbyin steng na gnas/ /g.yon na bsil byed g.yas pa na/ /dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo sangs ma/

/srin por laṃ las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thong pa 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po nyid la'o/ /ḍaṃ las skyes pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlungs mtshams thag zangs ris stengs gshegs/ /g.yon pa sdigs 'dzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyil dkrungs phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag gis gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams ni rnam dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yis/ /bde rab ster 'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi g.yas pa'i phyag bzung ba'i/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la//rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyis nyid kyi 'khor lo 'di la ni/ /'jigs rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid kyi 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa/ /zhi ba'i bde gtso rig ma bsdud mdzad pa/ /shes rab chags pa bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyis/ /gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro ma gtso kyai rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog/zhes pas bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas gtor ma nang mchod chu dang chang gis sbyangs te/ rdo rje'i rtse'am/ mtheb srin gyis gtor ma la nang mchod gtor la/ sngar ltar bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ gsum brtseg gi steng gi lte ba dang 'dab ma'i oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pas las/ dbus su sku rdo rje| shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug byang shar du 'bring gi ri ti/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/

nub byang du gzhon nu karti ka thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la gnyis su med pas sbyor ba/ bar gyi 'dab ma'i lte bar sngar gyi lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma'i hūm̐ brgyad yongs su 'gyur pa las/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan| shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la mnyam par sbyor ba/ 'og gi pad ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma'i a dgu yongs su 'gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong*| nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ thams cad kyang mdog dmar po/ pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas mnyam par sbyor ba/ kun kyang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha thams cad lha chen po brgyad la bsdus| kyai rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa steng gi sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la bsdus/ gsung rdo rje thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og gi sems can thams cad klu chen po brgyad la bsdus par mos te/ sa steng sa bla sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ phyag rgya bcas/ mdun bskyed ltar skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas| ni ri ti la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra ka ya wā k+tsit+ta sa pa ri wā ra/ gau ri ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥl sogs pas dam tshig pa la bstim/

mdun bskyed ltar dbang bskur bas/ steng ma rnams la rnam snang*/ bar ma rnams la mi skyod pa/ 'og ma rnams la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa'i dbus nas 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya byas la| oṃ e h+ye hi/ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṣi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wāk+tsit+ta/ in+da| dza ma/ dza la/ dza k+kha/ bhu ta/ bāh+ṇi/ bā u/ rak+kha/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā da/ bap+pa/ ta la/ pā ta la/ a ṭ+ṭa sap+pa swaha/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñja/ dzi gha/ phu l+la/ dhu pa/ māṃ sa| piṃ gha/ am+bha/ sap+pa/ kadz+dza/ sā da/ khan+ti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ āḥkā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇī ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐phaṭa sāhā/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ ni ri ti la sogs pas mchod/ kā ya wāk+tsit+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod gtor/ dkar mo ri dwags la sogs dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyi rjes su/ mi skyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen mo/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin| |'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod| |don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid la byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod| |zhes pas bstod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*/

/gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen 'byung ba dang*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yis/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsaul/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la bsrungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog |zhes pas phrin las gzhol/ ko l+la i ri ṭṭhi/ a bo la mu m+mu ni ri/ ka k+ko la| gha ṇa kri pi ta ho badz+dza i/ kā ru ṇiki/ a i na ro la ta hiṃ ba la kha dz+dza.i/ ga ṭā+eṃ ma a na pi dz+dza a i/ ha le ka lin dza ra pā ni a i/ du dhu ra badz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kastu ri si h+la/ ka pu ra la i a i/ ma la i/ in dhā nā sā liṃ dza/ ta hiṃ bha ru kha i a i/ phreng kha na khe tra ka ran ḍe shud dha/ a shud dha/ n+na ma ni a i| ni raṃ su a/ ga tsa ṭa wī/ ta hiṃ dza/ sa rā wa pa ni a i/ ma la a tshe/ kun dhu ru/ ba ṭa i/ ḍi ṇ+ḍi mā tahi na badz+dzi/ a i/ zhes pas rdo rje'i glu blangs/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/

/sangs rgyas pad+mo rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin/ /de'i nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ / chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ / rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyi legs par bsam pa dang*/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags kun gyi mthu stobs dang*/ /bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis/ /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*| |brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*/ /snyan pa nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa dang*/ /gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*| |'dod pa bsgrub cing phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung 'gyur

ba| |lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*/ /bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// mnyam par 'jog cing shes rab bskyed pa ste/ /drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i dgung la bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi deng 'dir gsol/ /zhes pas bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can| |smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rje ldan/ skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*| |btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shogasems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa/ /gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba/ /des ni sangs rgyas myur thob shog/zhes pas smon lam btab/ de nas 'das gtor gnyis pa yod na/ bde mchog la dbul zhing*/ gtor ma gsum la lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ g.yas bstan te āḥzhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan par 'gyur pa/ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar gyur/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te/ ho zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ zhes brjod pas lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas| mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng du| paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ 'thing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las| rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/

g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kar gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi ghan+ṭi bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan pa| rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can| rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su bya nagagayon du khyi nag rgyab na ce spyang*/ mdun na mi nagasteng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du/ trag las e ka dza ti sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ bh+yo las 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung*/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing/ ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re ldai'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas la dug sbrul dang*/ g.yon la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig lai dang*/ zhag gi zo ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yo'i sgra sgrogs pa/

lcam dral gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang*| rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo spyan drangs par mos la/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba mgon po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la 'dzub mo g.yab pa'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mgon po 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya e h+ya he/ zhes pa dang rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba lha mo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya g.yab pa'am/ dril bu'i sgras/ lha mo 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /sogs dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā li de wī o h+ya hes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ shrī ma hwa kā la ye/ ma hā kā li de wī gṛh+ne daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta'i bar mchod/ so so'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas te spyi bor bzhag par mos te/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye/ ma hā kā li de wī ye/ sa ma ye/ sma ra ye/ sa ma ye/ ma ti kra ma ye/ sa ma ye/ rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang daṃ las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig bsrung*| bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ khyad par du bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyi 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/

gal te zhi bas gdul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang*/ bskrad cing gzir ba dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ bsdigs shing dpa' skong bar mdzad du gsol| mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin 'grub cing*/ bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ ces pas phrin las bcol/ sngar bzhin gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā ka li de wī ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga to/ bh+yau bi shwa mu kha bh+yaḥ sarba tad+khaṃ ud+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba lin+ta ye swāhā/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ gong lta mchod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya shā sa na u pa ha ṇi/ e ṣa a paṣ+tsā ma kā lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇaṃ/ ya de pra ti dz+nyaṃ?/ sma ra bi ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+taṇa/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ya/ ma ra ya/ gṛh+na gṛh+na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de na me ke na ma ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces gzungs ring dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ mgon po'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ro ru ru ro ru bhī tiṣ+ṇa/ wā to si ka ma la rāk+ṣa sī hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ zhes lha mo'i snying po la nang mchod gtor/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ rnga brdung zhing*/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can| |tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jig par byed/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs 'thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod phreng can la bdag bstod do/ khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab sgyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying byin pa/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā lā ya/

/lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ / ma hā de wa'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po ma hā kā la ye/ / 'jigs byed chen po ma hā kā la ye/ /legs ldan nag po grong khyer gsum rtseg dgra| |bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma nag po che/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma nag po che/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra lha nag po che/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gy-i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/dzaṃ bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /sman rag phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyen paur bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du bsgrubs/ /zhes dang*/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyis mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod kyi sku/ /ri rab lhun po lta bur brjid/ /dbang po sngon po lta bur 'bar/ /nyi ma'i zer ltar sprul pa 'gyed/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmarapo glog ltar 'khyug /mi ro khar bcug mche ba gtsigs/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon chas phyag rnams brel/ /mi mgo rin chen rus pas spras/ /klu dbang seng ge lcags sgrog dang*/ khrag dang zhag gi thegs les brgyan/ /ko rlon re lde gos su gyon/ /bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo rgyu/ / shin tu rid cing mi sdug ma/ /'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra bsgrags pas/ khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas/ /sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la 'dud/ khyod thugs zhi la rab zhol yang*/

/snying rje'i dbang gis srid la bzhugs/ khro dang 'khrugs dang rngam pa yi/ /bdud dpung nges par 'joms la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi la sogs kyis bstod cing phrin las gzhol/ de nas gtor ma bzhi pa oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥs sngar bzhin byin gyis brlab/ mdun du paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las gtso 'khor lnga dus gcig tu skyed de/ /dbus su nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa g.yas rtsegs ma gnyis sngon po/ g.yon rtsegs ma gnyis ljang khu/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po gri gug g.yon dang po thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin zhing*/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas mi rus kyi phreng ba phyar thabs su bsnams pa/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa mchan khung du thogs pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la zhabs g.yas skum zhing g.yon brkyang pas bzhengs pa/ skug mdog nag po/ dbu skra kham ser gyen la 'bar ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum bsgrad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa ma mchu 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ tshangs pa'i skud pa'i se ral kha byas pa/ drag la rngam pa'i cha lugs can/ ngag tu ha ha dang hūṃ hūṃ gi gad rgyang sgrogs pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang khu| mdun du srin mo dmar nagargyab tu siṃ ga la ser nag thams cad kyang gcer mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba| g.yon thod khrag gtso bo la stob pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs can/ lnga ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūṃ bsam/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ te si sil ba'i tshal/ po ta la ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs par mos la/

sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin| |'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta ḍoṃ bhi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa li rā k+ṣa sī siṃ ga li de wā sa pa ri wā ra eh+ye his spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ pad+ma ka ma la staṃ gyis gdan dbul/ sa pa ri wā ri'i rjes su gṛh+ṇa daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā ḍo mi ni tsaṇ+ḍa li rā k+ṣa si siṃ ga li de wi/ sa ma ye sma ra ye nas phrin las gzhol ba'i bar dang*/ na maḥsarba ta tha ga te la sogs pa btags la sngar bzhin gtor ma 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ de wī rjes su oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la phud kyi mchod/ dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang sgyur zhing*/ /mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrogs dril bu phreng bas brgyan pa yis/ /gzhon nu'i lus can bgegs 'joms khyod la 'dud/ /du ma'i ming can drag po'i phreng ba can/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i mig gis bdud 'joms shing*/ /brkyang bskum glog stong 'gyu ba'i khro gnyer can/ /mdung thung gri gug bum thod 'dzin la bstod/ 'jigs byed myur 'gro tshang skud mi mgo ya/ /'phreng ba 'dzin cing sa gsum skrag byed pa// k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ sgra sgrogs srin po'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba khyod la bstod/ /dpal ldan gru 'dzin chen po ni/ khyod bzhugs ti si'i gangs ri la// gdong bzhi ldan khyod zhing skyong mdzad/ /kun srung khyod la bstod par bya/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ sgrogs pa'i dpal khyod kyis/ /srid gsum gnas pa'i bgegs rnams kun/ /skrag mdzad khyod la bstod par bya/

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru/ /dam bcas don 'di da lta 'dir/ /bsgrub la thogs pa med 'gyur ba'i/ /dam tshig ldan khyod bstod par bya/ /sha chen zan dang me tog spos/ /chang phud sha khrag la dga' ba/ khyod ni byang na rab bzhugs shing*| |phyogs bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang*| |seng ga la gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar dang ljang nag khros pa'i zhal// gri gug thod 'dzin bstod par bya/ khyod kyis rang phyogs legs bsrung shing*// gzhan phyogs rnam par sun by-in pa/ /don gnyis grub pa'i yab yum la/ / bdag gis rtag tu bstod par bya/ /de ltar bstod pas rab bsngags pas/ / bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang*/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ / bgegs rnams ma lus med par mdzod/ khyed kyi sgrub pa'i las bya zhing*/ /rjes su sgrubs na brtse ba dang*/ /yongs su bsten na gyes pa dang*/ /sun 'byin rnam par gzhom par mdzod/ /klog pa rnams ni rgyas pa dang*/ kha don phun gsum tshogs pa dang*/ /bsgrub pa dṛ ma med pa yi/ /bstan pa dag kyang dar bar mdzod| |mdor na gang dang gang bcol ba/ /de dang de'i las rnams la/ / btang snyoms g.yel ba ma mdzad par/ /bdag la rjes su brtse bar mdzod/ /

ces pas bstod/ de nas gtor ma lnga pa/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs sngar ltar byin gyis brlab| 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la oṃ badz+ra ā ra li ho dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya staṃ tṛ sh+ya hos spyan drangs/ sngar bzhin phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta pre ta pi shā tsi ud+man+da a pasma ra ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba lin gṛh+na tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhiṃ me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ| ya thai ṣ+taṃ/ bhun+dza thā/ dzi gha tha/ pi wa thā/ mā ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sad su khaṃ bi shung+nghe swāhā/ yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ mchod pas mchod la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro nas sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod gtor la/ bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas gtor ma drug pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bskyed/ a kā ros dbul/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phud gtor la/ gtor ma 'di gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo| |mchod do/ /'drain no/ /sbyin no/ /gsol lo'i rjes su bstan pa dar sogs gong ltar brjod/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyi rtsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces pas nongs pa bshags/ sngar ltar smon lam gdab bo/ / bzhi pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ phud bla ma dang*/ yi dam chos skyong la dbul/ rang he ru kar dran pa'i lag pa g.yas dgang gzar g.yon blugs gzar/ kha thab khung*/ lte ba nas 'bar ba'i gtum mo'i mes lus thams cad gang ba'i snying khar bla ma dang*/

yi dam/ lte bar chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i lha bza' btung bsreg rdzas su mos nas/ lha mchod pa'i bsam pas ma chags par longs spyod do/ /lhag ma la 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas chang gi kha phru btab ste/ oṃ u tsiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas sngar bzhin rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /kyai'i rdo rje 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /zhes pa'i rjes su sngar gyi smon lam btab/ de nas mdun gyi lha la phyi nang yid byung bstod pa'i mchod pas sngar bzhin mchod la/ sngar gyi bzod gsol gyi rjes su/ khyed kyi sems can gyi khams la rjes su brtse bas bka' bstsal zhing dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs te/ sems can gyi don mdzad na so so'i skye bo rnal 'byor la dbang ma thob pa rnams brjed ngas pa'am/ yo byad ma tshang ba la sogs pa nyes pa gang cung zad bgyis pa de dag bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yod na ji srid du 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du ye shes pa rnams 'di la bstan par bzhugs nas sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus par stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swāhās brtan par bzhug la/ rten med pa'am gshegs gsol dgos pa ni/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa dang gtor mgron rnams la dngos grub blang zhing gshegs su gsol lo/

/dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ 'das gtor gcig bar chad bsrung ba'i don du bzhag la/ gtor ma gzhan rol mo dang bcas pas sa gtsang sar khyer bas/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la dang*/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi 'pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khraud bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ / snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' lding bya khyi ce spyang 'khor dang bcas/ /pu tra la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs kyi rjes su/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun/ /dpal 'byor gyis rgyas yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*| |'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod/ /ces pas btab cing gtang nang du 'ongs te skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs bsrung*/ ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi'agro ba'i/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa/ / chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur te/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*/ /skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /gis bkra shis brjod/ lnga pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/

srod kyi bya ba rnams tshar nas gnyid log pa'i tshe/ rang gtso bo la thim/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros snod bcud bsrung 'khor la/ de gzhal yas khang dang de lha mo la/ de zhal la ste/ bet+ta li steng zhal la'o/ /yum yab la/ yab hūm̐ la thim ste/ mi dmigs pa'i stong pa'i ngang la nyal lo/ / drug pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas stong pa las kyai rdo rje'i skur bzhengs pa'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros lha gzhas yas khang snod bcud rnams dmigs nas rang gzugs sku snod bcud phrin las 'jug pa'i yul du mos la ldang ngo*/ / bdun pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ dbang bskur dang 'dra ba las khyad par dbang bskur bas phyi nang gi dri ma dag lus sems ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam ste/ yig brgya brjod cing khrus bya/ dbang gi lha gshegs su gsol/ brgyad pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ mnyam gzhag las ldang ba'i dus kun tu lha mo brgyad zhal/ yab phyag gnyis par bsdus nas gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi bsrung*/ skyai mched drug gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa drugagazugs gau ri ma/ sgra tsau ri ma/ dri bait+ta li| ro ghasma ri/ reg sa spyod/ chos kyi skye mched mkha' spyod/ snang ba lha/ grags pa sngags/ sems kyi 'gyu ba ting nge 'dzin du bsams la/ zung 'jug gi ngang las lhas lha la mchod pa'i bsam pas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod cing*/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i spyod lam rnam bzhi ci bder spyod/ tshul 'di lta bu dus rtag tu gnas na thun mong mchog gi dngos grub myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /tshul 'di 'grel pa dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung 'ga' re dang*/ mi mthun pa yod kyang*/ rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa dag gi bzhed pa dang phyag len ji lta ba bzhin yin pas/ khungs btsun par khong du chud par bya'o zhes chos rje bla ma dam pas gsungs pa 'di dar rgyas shin tu che bas tshig ris ji bzhin bris nas ma tshang pa nges par 'gengs dgos pa re re tsam kha bskang zhing*/
